subject: SentryCare residency + auditlog pricing: tiered discounts & velocity ask
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <aramos@sentrycare.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@sentrycare.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Residency + KMS/HSM + audit log: pricing ask and RFQ

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the chat yesterday. SentryCare is preparing an RFQ for our next-year budget and we need formal pricing for the following scope so procurement can evaluate:

- Data residency: US-east physical residency (SOC2 evidence required)
- Audit logs: append-only audit log retention for 36 months, searchable export on request
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys preferred (bring-your-own-key) + HSM-backed signing for PB-level ops
- HIPAA readiness confirmation and implementation SOW estimate

We have two procurement questions we hope you can address in the quote:
1) If we commit to a 12-month reserved capacity (estimated baseline throughput 1.2B tokens/month), what kind of discount can you offer on the compliance add-ons (audit logs + KMS/HSM)?
2) We expect ramp: first 3 months 50% of baseline, then up to 150% by month 6. Is there a velocity or usage-based credit you can apply during the ramp window?

Attached is our RFQ (high level). Can you return a line-item quote + any required implementation fees by EOD Wednesday? If helpful, we can do a 20-minute call tomorrow morning.

Appreciate it —
Alex Ramos
Director, Procurement
SentryCare

Attachment: RFQ-SentryCare-20260824.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <aramos@sentrycare.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Residency + KMS/HSM + audit log: pricing ask and RFQ

Alex —

Thanks for the RFQ and clear requirements. We can absolutely support US-east residency, BYOK with HSM seats, and 36-month audit log retention. High level answers up front:

- 12mo reserved capacity (1.2B tokens/mo baseline): we can provide a blended discount on the compliance bundle (audit logs + KMS/HSM seats + residency support) in the range of 12-18% depending on payment cadence and onboarding milestones.
- Velocity credit: we can structure a ramp credit that returns up to 10% of the compliance add-on spend for months 1-3 if usage reaches the ramp thresholds you outlined (50% -> 150%). Credits would be delivered as monthly invoice credits.

I'll pull together a line-item draft and share an initial workbook (attached). Two quick asks so the quote is tighter:
1) Please confirm expected average sequence length / token mix (chat vs. embeddings vs. fine-tuned calls) so we can estimate compute xfer costs.
2) Will SentryCare need quarterly evidence bundles (we can include a paid evidence delivery option) or is access to our audit log export API sufficient?

Proposing a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00am PT with Jordan (technical SLA), Ben (billing) and me to finalize assumptions — does that work?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Deals, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SentryCare-draft-pricing-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 85KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Alex Ramos / SentryCare RFQ — pricing floor guidance requested

Team — forwarding RFQ from SentryCare. They asked for a 12mo reserved discount and a velocity-style credit for ramp months. Draft workbook attached.

Quick notes inline below from my read:

> RFQ: 1.2B tokens/mo baseline, ramp 50% -> 150% in first 6 months; 36mo audit logs; BYOK HSM seats.

Ben — what is the lower bound we can accept on compliance bundle discount for a deal this size (assume net-new account, mid-market with aggressive uptime SLA)?
Irene — what operational effort and one-time evidence cost should we assume for 36mo retention + quarterly evidence bundles?
Jordan — any SLA or throughput caveats we should flag for their reserved pool assumptions?

Ben (quick reply): "floor is ~10% on add-ons for 12mo commit if we keep evidence delivery as self-serve; push to 15% if we amortize implementation over 12 months and take an upfront invoice. For HSM seats, amortize onboarding fees across first 6 months to keep cashflow reasonable."

Irene (quick reply): "36mo retention increases storage/ingest cost — recommend a one-time implementation fee for evidence export mapping ($25k) + $0.02/GB/mo thereafter unless they accept self-service exports. Quarterly evidence bundles will need an SOW add-on unless they accept our standard auditlog API."

Jordan (quick reply): "Need to validate their 1.2B tokens assumption; if sequences are long it will change our kernel selection and therefore effective throughput; propose we add a clause that reserved pool is sized for verified token mix at handoff."

I'll fold these into the workbook and send updated proposal to Alex.

Karthik
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <aramos@sentrycare.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: SentryCare pricing proposal (residency + audit logs + KMS/HSM) — v2

Alex —

Appended is our formal line-item proposal based on the RFQ and the assumptions you confirmed on the call. Highlights:

- Compliance bundle (audit logs + BYOK HSM support + residency enablement): list $120,000/mo.
  - 12mo reserved commit discount: 15% off compliance bundle if paid annually upfront; 12% if paid monthly with a 12mo term.
- HSM seats: $30,000 one-time onboarding (amortizable over 6 months) + $6,000/month per HSM seat for management/support.
- Audit log retention: 36 months retained. Storage/ingest: $0.02/GB/mo. One-time evidence mapping & SOW: $25,000 (waived for pilot).
- Velocity ramp credit: months 1-3 we will apply monthly credits up to 10% of compliance bundle spend if usage meets the ramp thresholds (50% baseline month 1, 100% baseline month 3, 150% by month 6). Credits appear on the invoice following the qualification month.
- SLA/Pool sizing clause: reserved pool will be sized to the verified token mix at implementation handoff; we will include a reconciliation clause for significant deviations.

Pilot concession: for pilot customers who execute a 3-month pilot PO we will waive the $25k evidence mapping fee and apply a 5% pilot credit on month 1 spend.

Link to proposal doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSentryCareProposal
Attachment: SentryCare-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf (pdf, 92KB)

Next steps: if this aligns, please send a PO for the pilot and indicate whether you prefer the annual upfront payment or monthly billing with a 12mo term. Also confirm if quarterly evidence bundles are required or if auditlog API access suffices for your compliance team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Deals | Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Thanks, this is helpful and close to what procurement needs. We will sign a 3-month pilot PO to validate token mix and will take the pilot concession (waive $25k evidence mapping).

Two items before we issue the PO:
1) Please add a short rollback clause that allows SentryCare to revert residency placement if there is an operational blocker identified during pilot (limited to first 30 days after go-live).
2) Confirm the velocity credit calculation method in writing (we agree to the thresholds, want credit examples on a $120k/mo baseline).

If you can update the PDF with those clarifications, procurement will route the PO by Friday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Alex Ramos
Director, Procurement
SentryCare
